verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a tax-compliance API, so cross-border B2B VAT handling is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only adjacent features: sales-tax estimates, exemption records and certificates, and address suggestions. Nothing shows VAT or tax ID validation against official registries, or automatic reverse-charge handling for B2B cross-border sales.

support.subject: As a developer, B2B cross-border sales are handled correctly — VAT and tax IDs validated against official registries in real time, reverse charge applied when it should be
